title: 第0011章 紫芝王开花第0012章 白芷祭神血染辛夷
lines: 那朵黑色的花，是在子夜时分彻底绽放的。
没有惊天动地的声响，只有一种令人毛骨悚然的寂静。仿佛整个药王沟的活物都在这一刻屏住了呼吸，等待着某种古老而邪恶的仪式完成。
青黛就站在那株巨大的紫芝王面前，连眼睛都不敢眨一下。
借着天上那轮诡异的紫色月光，她看清了那朵花的全貌。它不像寻常花朵那样舒展，而是像一颗刚刚停止跳动的心脏，层层叠叠的黑色花瓣紧紧包裹着中心，表面流淌着类似水银般的金属光泽。花蕊不是黄色的，而是一簇簇细密的、还在微微颤动的暗红色肉芽，像极了刚出生的婴儿还没长开的指头。
“真美……”青黛喃喃自语，声音里带着一丝颤抖。她伸出手，想要触碰那朵花，指尖在距离花瓣半寸的地方停住了。
一股寒意顺着指尖直冲天灵盖。那不是温度的冷，而是一种来自灵魂深处的战栗。她感觉那朵花是有意识的，它正在“看”着她，用一种高高在上、悲悯又贪婪的眼神。
突然，那簇暗红色的肉芽花蕊猛地收缩了一下，紧接着，一股肉眼可见的黑色雾气从花心中喷薄而出。
青黛下意识地后退一步，那股黑雾并没有散去，而是像有生命一样，贴着地面迅速蔓延开来。
被黑雾笼罩的几株小紫芝瞬间枯萎，化作了一滩滩黑水。而那些原本死气沉沉的荒坟，却在黑雾的滋养下，坟头上的杂草以肉眼可见的速度疯长，瞬间变成了半人高的墨绿色荆棘，张牙舞爪地刺向天空。
青黛终于意识到，这朵花开出来的不是生机，是纯粹的“毒”。是这药王沟千百年来积攒的所有怨气、死气和贪婪，在这一刻凝结成的实体。
就在这时，一阵急促的脚步声打破了坟地的死寂。
“青黛！青黛你在哪儿！”
是雪见的声音。
青黛回过头，看见雪见深一脚浅一脚地踩着荆棘丛跑了过来。她那只长满藤蔓的左手此刻正散发着幽幽的绿光，似乎在与这漫天的黑雾抗衡。
“你疯了吗？”雪见冲到青黛面前，一把将她拉开，“离那东西远点！你没看见它在吃周围的草吗？”
青黛稳住身形，看着雪见那只发光的手，突然笑了，笑得有些癫狂：“吃？雪见，你还没明白吗？这就是‘药王’的真面目。它不吃草，它吃的是命。独活的命，这满山孤魂的命，还有……咱们的命。”
“你说什么胡话！”雪见厉声喝道，但眼神却不由自主地飘向那朵黑花。
就在两人说话的功夫，那朵黑花的花瓣突然缓缓张开了一道缝隙。
一声低沉的嗡鸣声从花心中传出，震得两人耳膜生疼。紧接着，无数细小的黑色孢子从花蕊中喷涌而出，像是一场黑色的暴雪，向着整个药王沟飘散而去。
“快捂上口鼻！”雪见大喊一声，一把扯下衣角捂住半夏的口鼻——原来半夏不知何时也跟了过来，正痴痴地看着那朵黑花，嘴角流着绿色的口水。
“娘……好香啊……”半夏的声音含糊不清，“我想吃……我想变成花……”
雪见心头大骇，她感觉掌心的藤蔓正在疯狂地躁动，似乎想要挣脱她的身体，去拥抱那些黑色的孢子。她死死按住左手，指甲深深掐进肉里，用疼痛来保持清醒。
“青黛！快想办法！这孢子要是落到村里，大家都得死！”雪见吼道。
青黛看着漫天飘散的黑色孢子，眼神中闪过一丝决绝。她从包里掏出那张转让合同，又掏出打火机。
“没办法了。”青黛咬着牙说，“这花是冲着地来的。这地认主了，它要清洗掉所有不属于它的东西。”
“你什么意思？”
“意思就是，”青黛点燃了合同，火苗瞬间吞噬了那张纸，“这药王沟，从今天起，姓青了。既然它是药王，那就得听主人的话。”
她将燃烧的纸片扔向那株紫芝王。
火焰接触到紫芝粗糙的表皮的瞬间，并没有燃烧起来，反而像是被吸收了一样，瞬间熄灭。
那朵黑花似乎被激怒了。
一股强大的气浪从花心中爆发，直接将青黛和雪见掀翻在地。
雪见重重地摔在泥水里，她感觉自己的五脏六腑都移位了。她挣扎着抬起头，看见那朵黑花正在以肉眼可见的速度变大，黑色的花瓣像是一张张贪婪的大嘴，开始吞噬周围的光线。
原本紫色的月光被黑花吞噬，整个乱葬岗陷入了伸手不见五指的黑暗。
黑暗中，只有雪见掌心的藤蔓还在散发着微弱的绿光。
“娘……”半夏的声音在黑暗中响起，带着一丝恐惧，“我怕……”
雪见摸索着爬过去，一把抱住半夏。她感觉儿子的身体滚烫，皮肤下的绿色叶脉正在疯狂地搏动，似乎随时都会破体而出。
“别怕，娘在。”雪见紧紧搂着儿子，眼泪混着泥水流进嘴里，咸得发苦。
就在这时，她掌心的藤蔓突然猛地刺入地面。
一股清凉的气息顺着藤蔓涌入雪见的身体，瞬间驱散了周围的黑暗和恐惧。
雪见惊讶地发现，在藤蔓刺入的地方，竟然长出了一株株白色的小花。那些小花散发着柔和的白光，像是一盏盏明灯，照亮了周围的一小片天地。
是雪见草。
她终于明白了。
content_en:
The black flower fully bloomed at midnight.
There was no earth-shattering sound, just an eerie silence. It was as if all the living creatures in Yaowanggou held their breath at this moment, waiting for the completion of some ancient and evil ritual.
Qingdai stood in front of the huge Zizhi King, not even daring to blink.
Through the strange purple moonlight in the sky, she could see the whole flower clearly. It is not stretched like ordinary flowers, but like a heart that has just stopped beating. The layers of black petals tightly wrap the center, and the surface is flowing with a metallic luster like mercury. The stamens are not yellow, but clusters of fine, dark red buds that are still trembling slightly, like the fingers of a newborn baby that have not yet grown.
"It's so beautiful..." Qingdai murmured to herself, with a tremor in her voice. She stretched out her hand, wanting to touch the flower, but her fingertips stopped half an inch away from the petals.
A chill ran down his fingertips and reached the sky. It was not a cold temperature, but a tremor coming from the depths of the soul. She felt that the flower was conscious and that it was "looking" at her with a superior, compassionate and greedy look.
Suddenly, the cluster of dark red granulated stamens shrank suddenly, and then, a black mist visible to the naked eye spurted out from the center of the flower.
Qing Dai subconsciously took a step back. The black mist did not dissipate, but spread rapidly against the ground as if it were alive.
"Ahem..."
Several small purple mushrooms shrouded in black mist instantly withered and turned into puddles of black water. However, those originally lifeless barren graves were nourished by the black fog. The weeds on the graves grew wildly at a speed visible to the naked eye, and instantly turned into dark green thorns half a man's height, piercing the sky with claws and teeth.
Qingdai finally realized that what bloomed from this flower was not life, but pure "poison". It is the entity that all the resentment, death energy and greed accumulated in Yaowanggou for thousands of years have condensed into at this moment.
Just then, a rush of footsteps broke the dead silence of the cemetery.
"Qingdai! Qingdai, where are you!"
It was Xuejian's voice.
Qing Dai turned around and saw Xue Jian running over, stepping on the thorn bushes one foot at a time. Her left hand covered with vines was emitting a faint green light at the moment, seeming to be contending with the black mist in the sky.
"Are you crazy?" Xuejian rushed to Qingdai and pulled her away, "Stay away from that thing! Didn't you see it eating the grass around it?"
Qingdai steadied her body, looked at Xuejian's glowing hand, and suddenly smiled, a little crazy: "Eat? Xuejian, don't you understand yet? This is the true face of the 'King of Medicine'. It doesn't eat grass, it eats life. The life of living alone, the life of this mountain of lonely souls, and...our life."
"What nonsense are you talking about!" Xuejian shouted sharply, but her eyes could not help but drift towards the black flower.
Just as the two of them were talking, the petals of the black flower suddenly slowly opened a gap.
"Buzz——"
A low humming sound came from Hua Xin, which made the eardrums of the two people hurt. Immediately afterwards, countless tiny black spores spurted out from the stamens, like a black blizzard, floating towards the entire Yaowang Valley.
"Hurry up and cover your mouth and nose!" Xuejian shouted, pulling off his clothes and covering Banxia's mouth and nose - it turned out that Banxia had followed him at some point, looking at the black flower infatuatedly, with green drool dripping from the corner of his mouth.
"Mom...it smells so good..." Banxia's voice was unclear, "I want to eat...I want to become a flower..."
Xue Jian was horrified. She felt that the vines in her palm were stirring crazily, as if they wanted to break away from her body and embrace those black spores. She held her left hand firmly, digging her nails into her flesh, using the pain to stay awake.
"Qing Dai! Find a way! If these spores fall into the village, everyone will die!" Xuejian shouted.
Qingdai looked at the black spores floating in the sky, a trace of determination flashed in her eyes. She took out the transfer contract from her bag and then took out the lighter.
"There is no other way." Qingdai gritted her teeth and said, "This flower came for the earth. The earth has recognized its owner, and it wants to clean away everything that does not belong to it."
"What do you mean?"
"It means," Qingdai lit the contract on fire, and the flames instantly swallowed up the paper, "from today on, this Yaowang Gou has a surname of Qing. Since it is the Yaowang, it must listen to its owner."
She threw the burning piece of paper at the Zizhi King.
The moment the flame came into contact with the rough skin of Zizhi, it did not burn. Instead, it seemed to be absorbed and extinguished instantly.
The black flower seemed irritated.
"Boom!"
A powerful wave of air erupted from Hua Xin, directly knocking Qingdai and Xuejian to the ground.
Xuejian fell heavily into the muddy water, and she felt that her internal organs had been displaced. She struggled to raise her head and saw that the black flower was growing in size at a speed visible to the naked eye. The black petals were like greedy mouths, beginning to swallow up the surrounding light.
The original purple moonlight was swallowed up by the black flowers, and the entire mass grave fell into darkness.
In the darkness, only the vines in Xuejian's palm were still emitting a faint green light.
"Mom..." Banxia's voice sounded in the darkness, with a hint of fear, "I'm afraid..."
Xuejian crawled over gropingly and hugged Banxia. She felt that her son's body was hot, and the green veins under his skin were pulsing crazily, as if he would burst out of his body at any time.
"Don't be afraid, mother is here." Xuejian hugged her son tightly, tears mixed with mud and water flowed into her mouth, which was so salty that she felt bitter.
At this moment, the vines in her palm suddenly pierced into the ground.
A cool breath flowed into Xuejian's body along the vines, instantly dispelling the darkness and fear around him.
